articles.summary: We saw early engagement wins (up to +80% CTR and +35% OR). And then came the right question: “Does this translate to requests and revenue?” That reframed the work, and the product. Thumbtack pushed us to move beyond vanity metrics; they wanted to see if this engagement lift can translate into real revenue. Beyond metrics, the team wanted learnings: which segments actually matter, where personalization pays off, and whether AI can beat human creative.
articles.title: JustAI’s evolution with Thumbtack
